title: Aoyagi Toya — A Love Song Dedicated To You〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: A Love Song Dedicated To You（4★）
meta.Event: An Ode for the Pure of Heart

rows.Line: Wedding Ceremony Hall - Waiting Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our final rehearsal went pretty well.

rows.Speaker: Man A
rows.Line: Yeah, that was good! Wanna go take a break now?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I appreciate the offer, but I'd like to go check on my friend and the dance team first...

rows.Speaker: Man B
rows.Line: Sure, go for it! We'll see you later!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now then...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Stand more proudly! Be mindful of how you move your fingers as well! Imagine that each of your fingers has its own personality!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Kamishiro's really giving it everything he has. Our entire team's morale seems good too, so we should be able to pull this off.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Now, how's Akito doing...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Oh, wow... They're not looking bad themselves. I can't really complain...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that I asked Akito to do this...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Very good. The dance team is coming along nicely.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, yeah. I wouldn't be showing you this if we weren't.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Indeed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, let us get some rest before the...

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: Excuse me. The bride said that she'd like to go over things one last time before everything begins. Is there anyone available for that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, yes... I'll be right there...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Toya, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, hi. My team just decided to take a quick break.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then how about we go get some fresh air?
Wedding Ceremony Hall

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
This breeze is nice.
I'm glad it's so sunny out today. It's a perfect day for our little surprise.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I'm pretty amazed that we got this much done in this little time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I actually regretted saying yes to this when I saw the entire team for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Luckily, they're all pretty good at dancing and staying in rhythm, so it turned out to be pretty easy.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suspect how Kamishiro decided what we'd all be doing helped make that happen too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He even went through the trouble of asking each of us about our individual talents and experience.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really? He did that with all of you guys...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I've never done any acting before either, so choosing teams couldn't have been easy.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's got nothing to do with you. He's the one that agreed to take over, so it's all on him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I know. But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I think Akito has the wrong idea about Kamishiro...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He'd understand if he heard what I did back there from Kamishiro...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya? Hey, Toya, you there?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You mad or something?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This was originally between me and Tsukasa. I guess I just don't feel that great about roping you into this so suddenly...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Is that all...?
Dude, stop worrying so much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In your case, you're almost too passive, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you need help, just ask, but I'll say no when I want to. It's as simple as that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Plus, not all dances or dancers are the same. I think asking for my help was a good call this time around.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And I have nothing against Kamishiro if that's what you're worried about.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I knew he was egging me on to join, so it's all good.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Honestly, I just can't figure out what Kamishiro's thinking...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I do know that he's serious about making all these people happy with his show.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I can't make fun of someone like that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That's right. Akito's just...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I feel like I'm being played by him...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I said I'll help, so I'm giving it everything I've got. No ifs, ands or buts...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I think I was the one getting the wrong idea...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, let's make sure this surprise succeeds.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't worry, we will!
